caption: The drawing features a large rectangular arrangement of small, repeating three-dimensional cubes, which cover the central portion of the page. Each cube is made up of three diamond-shaped faces, with each face colored and patterned differently. The colors used in the composition include a variety of shades such as reds, yellows, greens, pinks, purples, blues, browns, and whites, as well as some muted tones. The patterns on the faces of the cubes vary, including stripes, polka dots, floral motifs, checks, and solid colors. The arrangement of cubes creates a tightly interlocked, tessellated pattern that fills the majority of the rectangle, set against a plain, beige background. The overall effect is created using a combination of colored and patterned sections, distributed evenly and randomly throughout the grid, with no apparent repetition of the same exact color-pattern combination in adjacent cubes. The edges of the page show some discoloration and slight wear.
title: Patchwork for Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
